title: Dinosaur waving hello
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="93" rx="34" ry="4" fill="#1f5c3a"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M28 78 Q10 76 6 62 Q14 68 26 66 Z" fill="#3ec46d"/>
  <path d="M28 78 Q10 76 6 62 Q14 68 26 66 Z" fill="#2ea45a" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#4ade80"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#b8f5cf"/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <rect x="58" y="84" width="12" height="9" rx="4" fill="#2ea45a"/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <rect x="32" y="84" width="12" height="9" rx="4" fill="#3ec46d"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M44 60 Q40 44 44 32 L56 32 Q58 46 56 60 Z" fill="#4ade80"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="26" rx="17" ry="15" fill="#4ade80"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="32" rx="11" ry="8" fill="#7feda6"/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d="M40 14 L34 20 L42 22 Z" fill="#facc15"/>
  <path d="M52 10 L48 18 L58 18 Z" fill="#facc15"/>
  <path d="M62 14 L60 22 L68 20 Z" fill="#facc15"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="22" rx="4.5" ry="5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="23" r="2.5" fill="#1b2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="21.5" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx="69" cy="29" r="1.5" fill="#2ea45a"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M60 36 Q66 39 71 36" stroke="#2ea45a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d="M62 62 Q76 56 80 40" stroke="#4ade80" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="38" r="5.5" fill="#7feda6"/>
  <!-- fingers -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="33" r="2.2" fill="#7feda6"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="31" r="2.2" fill="#7feda6"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="33" r="2.2" fill="#7feda6"/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d="M34 64 Q26 68 24 74" stroke="#3ec46d" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="75" r="4.5" fill="#7feda6"/>
  <!-- little motion lines near wave -->
  <path d="M88 30 L92 28" stroke="#facc15" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M88 38 L93 38" stroke="#facc15" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
